coverage.display: Sarah Okonkwo's Aetna Dental PPO coverage

note.text: Teledentistry claims-sharing package (one of two independent packages at Interaction 5). Meridian Teledental bills its own virtual consultation — a single line, D9995, Place of Service 02 (carried via item.locationReference -> loc-meridian-virtual), rendered by Dr. Webb on 2026-07-14. This is the FHIR-native equivalent of the separate 837D the teledentistry provider files at 08:00 on 2026-07-16.

This is the first time this project's claims-sharing profile represents TWO independently-billing organizations for ONE coordinated episode of care. The two packages (this one and eob-inoffice-claims-sharing) are tied together only by a shared referral reference (supportingInfo -> ServiceRequest/servicerequest-referral, referral-id REF-2026-UC04A-001), not by a combined joint claim. The test is whether the profile's shape holds unchanged when used twice in parallel.

Bills Aetna Dental's commercial dental benefit directly — CDT alone (D9995) is what's required; no CPT crosswalk applies (dental payer, not medical), same reasoning established for UC02. NO prior authorization reference anywhere — this commercial plan requires none for D9995/D0220/D3330. Deliberately excluded, per this profile's non-financial design: unitPrice, net, total, adjudication.
